questions.question: Explain two religious responses to hate crime.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Christianity teaches that all humans are made in God's image (Genesis 1:27) and are equal before God — "There is neither Jew nor Gentile... for you are all one in Christ Jesus" (Galatians 3:28). Hate crimes contradict Jesus' command to "love your neighbour" and are always wrong. 2) Islam teaches that all humans are equal before Allah — "We created you from a single pair" (Surah 4:1).
